title: Hai Salaam Us Pey Jo Qaidi Bhi Hai Beemar Bhi Hai
body:
Hai salaam us pey jo qaidi bhi hai beemar bhi hai
Paaoon mein aablay hain aabloun mein khaar bhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehta tha touq-e-giraan tu hai meray hissey mein
Warna is fouj mein khanjar bhi hai talwaar bhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Poochaa ek shaqs ney shabbir teraa kaun hai
Rokay farmaaney lagay baba bhi hai sardaar bhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pahoonchey nazdeek jo laashey kay Sakina ney kahaa
Yeh meray baba ka bhaayi bhi alamdaar bhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pahoonchey nazdeek jo koofay kay toh boli Zainab
Sar bhi uriyaan hai, balwaa bhi baazaar bhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Dum rukh jaata hai aur sar bhi jhukh jaata hai
Touq yeh tangh nihaayath hai garaanbaar bhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Gar chey beemaar hoon par zor-e-imaamat kay sabab
Oontt bhi kheinchtaa hoon taaqath-e-raftaar bhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab inhey shimr nazar aata toh ro ro kehta
Yeh sitamgar bhi hai qaatil bhi khoonkhaar bhi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala mein toh fasi aaya khusha haal tera
Ab tu shabbir ka mujraee bhi hai zawaar bhi hai
